fusions.name: Last Foothold
fusions.desc: Looses an arrow at a target up to 7 tiles away that deals 22 rock damage, rising to 1.5 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Ram-Headed Shot
fusions.desc: A braced shot at a target up to 6 tiles away that deals 12 damage, leaves it 12% easier to wound for 5 seconds and stuns it for 1.2 seconds.

fusions.name: Sure Footing
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 24 damage for 10 seconds, and your armour rises by 8% while it holds.

fusions.name: Planted Stance
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 10%, and your rock resistance by 10%.
